says: The scoped path pattern of the outside-input-constructor rule names next/packages/libfabrika/src/data/id.ts and next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/ChaosState.ts, and neither file exists, so those two alternatives match nothing.

cost: The rule looks like it guards two files it cannot reach, and a new file later created at one of those paths would be held by a rule written for different code.
